# `kernel/execution/SemanticTransaction.js`

> **Source:** `webgpu-os/kernel/execution/SemanticTransaction.js`

SemanticTransaction.js — deterministic multi-target preview/commit contract. The coordinator never writes storage itself. Callers provide one atomic commit callback that must recheck every expected revision/hash in the same critical section as its writes. This module validates that exact request, emits explicit conflict choices, and creates a hash-bound undo record.

### `class SemanticTransactionCoordinator`

| Method | Signature | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `preview` | `async preview({ transactionId, actorId = '', summary = '', targets } = {})` | Build an immutable, deterministic semantic diff preview. |
| `commit` | `async commit(preview, { readCurrent, atomicCommit } = {})` | Re-read every target and invoke exactly one atomic commit callback. Conflicts are returned as inspectable records; the callback is never run. |
| `undo` | `async undo(receipt, { readCurrent, atomicCommit } = {})` | Apply the hash-bound inverse only if the committed targets are unchanged. |

## Notes & Examples

### Command Bus Pattern

The OS uses a capability-gated command bus for inter-app and system communication. Apps register command handlers; the kernel routes commands based on capabilities. Commands can be local (same app), cross-app (with permission), or system-level (elevated).

**Example: Command registration and invocation**
```js
import { CommandBus } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/CommandBus.js';
import { Capability } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/Capability.js';

const bus = new CommandBus();

// Register a handler (requires 'ui' capability)
bus.register('myapp:openFile', async (path) => {
  const content = await storage.read(path);
  return { content, size: content.length };
}, { capability: 'storage' });

// Invoke locally
const result = await bus.invoke('myapp:openFile', '/docs/readme.md');

// Cross-app invocation (requires 'interop' capability)
const otherApp = bus.proxy('otherapp');
const data = await otherApp.invoke('otherapp:compute', input);

// Broadcast to all listening apps
bus.broadcast('system:themeChanged', { theme: 'dark' });
```

**See also:** [WebGPU OS Architecture](/webgpu-os/architecture.md) · [Security Model](/concepts/security-model.md)
